abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.stove: Climate entity of the pellet stove, e.g. from MCZ Maestro local or the cloud integration.

user.description: Heating control for pellet stoves. It starts in shadow mode: it only calculates and switches nothing. Rooms, sensors and schedules are set up in the Wärmeregie panel.
user.title: Wärmeregie

boost.description: Raise or lower all room targets for a while.
boost.name: Adjust all targets

pause_stove.description: No stove start for this time. A running block ends.
pause_stove.name: Pause stove

pellets_empty.description: Reports an empty hopper. The consumption per burn hour is learned from this.
pellets_empty.name: Pellet hopper empty

pellets_refill.description: Adds the refilled amount to the estimated stock.

kg.description: Kilograms; default is one bag as set in the parameters.
kg.name: Amount

pellets_refill.name: Pellets refilled

pellets_set.description: Sets the pellet stock by hand.

from_empty.description: On: the hopper was empty before; the consumption will be learned from this fill.
from_empty.name: Hopper was empty

pellets_set.name: Set pellet stock

set_scene.description: Choose a scene manually. Without duration it lasts until the next schedule change.
set_scene.name: Set scene

warmup.name: Warm up the house
warmup.description: Start the stove now, even if it is warm enough, or in time for your arrival. Targets of the warm-up scene plus a little extra apply.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: Warm up now for this long (30-360 min). Ignored if an arrival time is given.

arrive.name: Arrival
arrive.description: Time you get home. Warming up starts early enough (see settings).

cancel_warmup.name: Cancel warm-up
cancel_warmup.description: Stop warming up and return to the schedule.

cold.name: I am cold
cold.description: Warmer for a while. Wärmeregie decides: if the boiler still holds heat it only opens the radiators, otherwise it starts the stove.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: The higher targets apply this long (30-360 min). Without a value the setting is used.

feedback.name: Give feedback
feedback.description: Say whether it is too cold, fine or too warm. Wärmeregie reacts at once and learns suggestions from it.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room id (as in Wärmeregie). Empty = whole house.

ai_suggest.name: Ask the AI for suggestions
ai_suggest.description: Sends an anonymous summary of settings and feedback to the AI set up in Wärmeregie. Suggestions appear in Wärmeregie; nothing is changed until you accept one.
